subject: Vendor setup: required compliance items, PO workflow, and DPA
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@nemera.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nemera.com
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — Redwood Inference (Nemera vendor intake)

Hi Rachel,

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood Inference so we can issue a PO and route invoices. Procurement needs the following from your side to complete vendor activation in Nemera's system: 

- Signed Data Processing Agreement (or DocuSign link to sign).
- Latest SOC 2 report (summary or SOC 2 Type II PDF).
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV or spreadsheet).
- Vendor legal name, tax ID (or W-9), and billing remit-to instructions.
- Preferred billing email and contact for invoice questions.

Can you send these items (or links) back today? We have a weekly vendor sync at 5pm PT and want Redwood entered before the next invoicing cycle.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Procurement Lead
Nemera Systems

Attachments: none on initial ask

From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@nemera.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Redwood Inference (Nemera vendor intake)

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the note — attaching what you requested and calling out a couple of points so procurement can map fields correctly: 

1) DPA: I've uploaded our current DPA and sent it for signature via DocuSign. Link: https://app.docusign.com/REDWOOD-DPA/abc123. If you prefer a redline first, let me know and I can loop legal.

2) SOC 2: Public summary is attached (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf). For a full report we usually provide it under NDA — tell me if you need the full auditor packet and I'll route it.

3) Subprocessors: attached CSV (subprocessors-2025.csv) with host regions and encryption notes.

4) Billing and PO info (also attached invoice sample):
   - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Tax ID: 83-174XXXX
   - Remit-to: payments@redwood.ai (PDF sample shows header fields)
   - Preferred billing email: ap-invoices@redwood.ai

5) PO path: Once you confirm the vendor code and PO number we invoice to PO# on the invoice header. Our invoices accept either emailed PDFs to ap-invoices@redwood.ai or EDI — if Nemera requires an AP portal, please share the upload link.

Please confirm once the DocuSign is sent to your team and if you need any additional fields in the CSV or invoice samples. CC'ing Karthik from our procurement ops to help with any required fields for Nemera's vendor form.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (pdf), SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (pdf), subprocessors-2025.csv (csv), invoice-sample-redwood.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@nemera.com>, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Redwood Inference (Nemera vendor intake)

Hi Olivia — quick note from finance ops:

- We'll assign a Nemera vendor code on our side once you confirm the PO# format and vendor ID you plan to use. If Nemera requires a remittance address on the PO, please include the exact string so it matches our invoice header.
- If Nemera needs vendor insurance certificates or a supplier questionnaire, flag which form (COI or full supplier questionnaire) and I'll send it over.
- If you prefer to route invoices to a specific project code or BU, include that mapping in the vendor setup.

Rachel: tagging you to confirm whether we should provide an NDA for SOC2 exchange or proceed with the summary attached.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

(Quoted) On Fri, 22 Aug 2025 at 11:02, rachel.kim@redwood.ai wrote:
> ...sending DPA via DocuSign and attached SOC 2 summary.

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@nemera.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Redwood Inference (Nemera vendor intake)

Thanks Rachel and Karthik — received everything and sharing next steps: 

- I'll route the DocuSign to our legal and procurement approvers today; expect a turnaround of 2–3 business days on the DPA unless we request a redline.
- SOC 2 summary OK to start; we will request the full auditor report under our standard NDA if we need deeper controls evidence. Please let me know the contact for NDAs if that comes up.
- Subprocessors CSV looks good; procurement will import it into our vendor system.
- For the PO: Nemera PO numbers are "NEM-YYYY-#####" — please ensure that string appears in the invoice "PO" field. Remittance address does not need to be in the PO but please include the vendor legal name and tax ID exactly as provided.

I'll confirm when the vendor is active and share the vendor code. Once active, we'll issue the first PO and route a PDF to ap-invoices@redwood.ai.

Olivia
Procurement Lead, Nemera Systems

--
Nemera procurement portal: https://procurement.nemera.com/vendor-portal (for uploads if needed)
